_about: tests/db/apply-extract.test.ts: one PDF spec sheet as scraper/run.py cisco-specs-pdf writes it (tier 1). The suite writes a real three-page PDF under scraper/cache/<sha1(source_url)>.bin whose page 1 holds a Parameter|Value table (document-scoped PARAM facts, locator without a column) and page 2 a Model|Height|Operating temperature grid (SKU-scoped). The document-scoped temperature is refused for NZT-UCS-C240 because the same document states it per SKU (class C exception); the weight is class B and never inherited; the height is a dimensions struct the parser refuses.
